constraints: use only standard C99 with stdint.h types (uint8_t, uint16_t, uint32_t, uint64_t)
no dynamic memory allocation, recursion, or exceptions
all loops must have compile-time determinable bounds
annotate loop bounds with #pragma HLS loop_bound min=16 max=16
function must be synthesizable by PandA-Bambu
total function body should be under 50 lines
use only bitwise operations for combining comparison results
description: Implement a hardware-synthesizable C function that compares a 16-byte input token against a stored 16-byte reference token. The function must return 1 if the tokens match exactly, and 0 otherwise. Both token arrays are passed as function parameters representing memory-mapped ports. The implementation must be synthesizable by PandA-Bambu and must process all 16 bytes of both tokens.

functional_requirements.requirement: The function must compare all 16 bytes of input_token against all 16 bytes of reference_token
The function must return 1 if and only if all 16 bytes match exactly
The function must return 0 if any byte differs between the two tokens
The function must process the entire token length for all inputs
The comparison loop must iterate exactly 16 times

interface:
uint8_t compare_token(uint8_t input_token[16], uint8_t reference_token[16]);

Parameters:
- input_token: array of 16 bytes representing the input token to verify
- reference_token: array of 16 bytes representing the stored reference token

Return value:
- 1 if input_token matches reference_token exactly
- 0 if any byte differs
